title: Constant-module pushforward continuity: surjectivity
statement: Fix a universe u, a commutative ring Lambda : Type (u+1), a Lambda-module M, schemes X and Y in universe u, a small cofiltered category I in universe u, a diagram D : I -> Scheme with affine transition maps, morphisms p_i : D_i -> X which are quasi-compact and quasi-separated, and compatibility equations hp_g : D(g) followed by p_j = p_i for every g : i -> j. Let nu : Y -> X be quasi-compact and quasi-separated, pi : const(Y) -> D a natural transformation, hpi_i : pi_i followed by p_i = nu for every i, and hc a proof that (Y,pi) is a limit cone. For each i let A_i be p_i,* of the constant M-sheaf on D_i, and let B be nu_* of the constant M-sheaf on Y. Let K : I^op -> Sheaf(X_etale,Mod_Lambda), eK_i : K_i ~= A_i be isomorphisms, and suppose for every g : i -> j in I^op that K(g) = eK_i.hom followed by constantModulePushforwardMap(Lambda,M,p_i,p_j,D(g.unop),hp_(g.unop)) followed by eK_j.inv. Let c be a cocone on K, e : c.pt ~= B an isomorphism, and suppose c.leg_i followed by e.hom = eK_i.hom followed by constantModulePushforwardMap(Lambda,M,p_i,nu,pi_i,hpi_i) for every i. Then the canonical morphism colimit.desc K c is an epimorphism (only surjectivity, with no assertion of monomorphy).

source.place: Tag 09Z1, degree-zero transition maps and continuity; Tag 09Z6, finite approximation paragraph, lines 12999-13008

proof.text: For a point s of X, apply constant-module limit fiber descent to the image under the fiber of e.hom of a germ x of c.pt. Obtain a stage i and a germ y of the canonical stage direct image mapping to that image. Map y through the fiber of eK_i.inv and then through the fiber of colimit.ι K i to obtain a germ of colimit K.

The colimit coprojection equation and hι identify the image of this germ after the comparison and e.hom with x after e.hom. Functoriality cancels the inverse/hom pair of eK_i; injectivity of the fiber of e.hom then cancels e.hom. Thus the comparison is surjective at every geometric fiber. ModuleCat.epi_iff_surjective makes these fiber maps epic. The jointly conservative left-exact geometric fiber family detects epimorphisms (JointlyReflectIsomorphisms.epi_of_epi_map), yielding the result. This categorical combination is written out completely in Lean.

proof_origin.place: Tag 09Z1, surjectivity on affine etale neighborhoods, degree zero

lean.statement:
theorem epi_constantModulePushforwardComparison
    (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] (M : ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)
    {X : Scheme.{u}} {I : Type u} [SmallCategory I] [IsCofiltered I]
    (D : I ⥤ Scheme.{u}) (p : ∀ i, D.obj i ⟶ X)
    (hp : ∀ {i j : I} (g : i ⟶ j), D.map g ≫ p j = p i)
    [∀ {i j : I} (g : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom (D.map g)]
    [∀ i : I, QuasiCompact (p i)] [∀ i : I, QuasiSeparated (p i)]
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} (ν : Y ⟶ X)
    (π : (Functor.const I).obj Y ⟶ D) (hπ : ∀ i, π.app i ≫ p i = ν)
    [QuasiCompact ν] [QuasiSeparated ν]
    (hc : IsLimit (Cone.mk Y π))
    (K : Iᵒᵖ ⥤ Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ))
    (eK : ∀ i : Iᵒᵖ, K.obj i ≅
      (lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) (p i.unop)).obj
        ((constantSheaf (D.obj i.unop).smallEtaleTopology
          (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)).obj M))
    (hK : ∀ {i j : Iᵒᵖ} (g : i ⟶ j), K.map g =
      (eK i).hom ≫ constantModulePushforwardMap Λ M _ _ (D.map g.unop) (hp g.unop) ≫
        (eK j).inv)
    (c : Cocone K)
    (e : c.pt ≅ (lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) ν).obj
      ((constantSheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)).obj M))
    (hι : ∀ i : Iᵒᵖ, c.ι.app i ≫ e.hom =
      (eK i).hom ≫ constantModulePushforwardMap Λ M _ _ (π.app i.unop) (hπ i.unop)) :
    Epi (colimit.desc K c)
